privacyPolicyPage_dados_de_conta_autenti: Account, authentication, and platform usage data
privacyPolicyPage_briefings_historias_de: Briefs, user stories, and acceptance criteria entered in the workspace
privacyPolicyPage_armazenamento_em_banco: Database storage for accounts, history, and projects
privacyPolicyPage_cookies_essenciais_ana: Essential cookies, optional analytics, and a saved preference for inactive marketing cookies
privacyPolicyPage_processamento_por_serv: Processing by AI services to support artifact generation
privacyPolicyPage_o_prodforge_e_uma_plat: ProdForge is an AI-powered web platform that helps product managers, product owners, and product teams create, improve, and standardize user stories, acceptance criteria, technical insights, and improvement suggestions.
privacyPolicyPage_esta_politica_de_priva: This Privacy Policy describes how ProdForge collects, uses, stores, and protects data when you use the website, public area, workspace, forms, and related features.
privacyPolicyPage_podemos_coletar_dados_: We may collect information you provide, data generated by product use, and technical data needed to keep the platform operating securely.
privacyPolicyPage_dados_de_cadastro_e_au: Registration and authentication data, such as your name, email, password protected by the authentication provider, plan, role, and account identifiers.
privacyPolicyPage_conteudos_inseridos_no: Content entered in forms, such as briefs, business problems, rules, constraints, user stories, acceptance criteria, technical notes, and project context.
privacyPolicyPage_historico_de_uso_verso: Usage history, generated versions, preferences, projects, invited members, and actions taken in the workspace.
privacyPolicyPage_dados_tecnicos_de_nave: Technical browsing data, such as pages visited, interaction events, device, browser, approximate IP address, date, time, and records needed for security and diagnostics.
privacyPolicyPage_dados_de_comunicacao_c: Communication data, such as messages submitted through forms, waitlist registrations, and requests made by email.
privacyPolicyPage_informacoes_necessaria: Information needed for potential monetization, subscriptions, usage limits, billing, fraud prevention, and plan management when those features are available.
privacyPolicyPage_usamos_os_dados_para_e: We use data to provide the core ProdForge experience, keep the platform secure, and improve product quality.
privacyPolicyPage_criar_e_manter_sua_con: Create and maintain your account, authenticate access, and enable workspace features.
privacyPolicyPage_gerar_revisar_salvar_v: Generate, review, save, version, and organize user stories, acceptance criteria, technical insights, and improvement suggestions.
privacyPolicyPage_entender_uso_desempenh: Understand usage, performance, errors, and friction to improve workflows, copy, the interface, models, and product features.
privacyPolicyPage_enviar_comunicacoes_re: Send account communications, email confirmations, product updates, responses to requests, and important notices.
privacyPolicyPage_proteger_a_plataforma_: Protect the platform against abuse, fraud, unauthorized access, operational failures, and use that harms other users.
privacyPolicyPage_gerenciar_limites_de_u: Manage usage limits, plans, and paid or experimental features when applicable.
privacyPolicyPage_dados_de_conta_projeto: Account data, projects, preferences, briefs, generated stories, versions, history, and operational events may be stored in databases and infrastructure services used to operate ProdForge.
privacyPolicyPage_esse_armazenamento_per: This storage supports content recovery, workspace continuity, access controls, troubleshooting, abuse prevention, and responding to user requests. Internal access must be limited to what is needed for operations, security, and support.
privacyPolicyPage_dados_inseridos_pelo_u: AI services may process information users enter to generate, improve, or supplement user stories, acceptance criteria, technical insights, refinement questions, and improvement suggestions.
privacyPolicyPage_a_qualidade_das_respos: Response quality depends on the context submitted. Review all generated content before using it in a backlog, documentation, Jira, discovery, refinement, or stakeholder communications.
privacyPolicyPage_voce_nao_deve_inserir_: Do not enter sensitive or confidential information, trade secrets, credentials, restricted financial data, health data, data about minors, or third-party personal data without authorization.
privacyPolicyPage_sempre_que_possivel_re: Whenever possible, remove or anonymize personal information before submitting a brief for AI processing.
privacyPolicyPage_podemos_usar_cookies_a: We may use cookies, local storage, technical identifiers, analytics events, and similar technologies for authentication, security, session management, usage measurement, and product improvements.
privacyPolicyPage_cookies_essenciais_sao: Essential cookies are required for the website and platform to work. Optional analytics can help measure usage, errors, and performance in aggregate and inform product improvements. Marketing cookies are currently inactive. The marketing setting saves your choice for future use.
privacyPolicyPage_voce_pode_aceitar_todo: On the Privacy Preferences page, you can accept or reject optional technologies or save preferences by category. Your browser stores your choice, and you can change it at any time.
privacyPolicyPage_nao_usamos_dados_pesso: We do not sell personal data sets to third parties. We may share data only when necessary to operate, protect, analyze, or improve ProdForge.
privacyPolicyPage_provedores_de_infraest: Infrastructure, hosting, database, authentication, email delivery, monitoring, and analytics providers.
privacyPolicyPage_servicos_de_ia_usados_: AI services that process instructions, briefs, and responses needed for platform features.
privacyPolicyPage_ferramentas_de_pagamen: Payment, billing, fraud prevention, and plan management tools when paid features are available.
privacyPolicyPage_autoridades_publicas_q: Public authorities where required by law, a valid order, or the need to protect rights, security, and product integrity.
privacyPolicyPage_adotamos_medidas_tecni: We use technical and organizational measures appropriate to the product's stage to protect information against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, alteration, or improper disclosure.
privacyPolicyPage_essas_medidas_podem_in: These measures may include authentication, access controls, audit logs, permission policies, isolation by user or project, error monitoring, and established infrastructure providers. No platform can promise absolute security.
privacyPolicyPage_mantemos_dados_pelo_te: We retain data as long as needed to provide the product, meet operational obligations, keep history requested by users, resolve disputes, prevent abuse, and meet legal or regulatory requirements when applicable.
privacyPolicyPage_conteudos_salvos_na_ba: Saved workspace content, versions, and history may remain linked to the account while useful to the product experience. We assess deletion requests based on technical feasibility, applicable obligations, and the need to retain minimal security records.
privacyPolicyPage_direitos_do_titular_co: Your rights under Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD)
privacyPolicyPage_nos_termos_da_lgpd_voc: Under the LGPD, you may request confirmation of processing, access to data, correction of incomplete, inaccurate, or outdated data, anonymization, blocking or deletion of unnecessary or improperly processed data, portability where applicable, information about sharing, review or withdrawal of consent, and objection to improper processing.
privacyPolicyPage_para_exercer_esses_dir: To exercise these rights, submit a request through the contact channel listed in this policy. Some requests may depend on identity verification, technical limits, retention of minimal records, compliance with a legal obligation, or protection of rights.
privacyPolicyPage_para_duvidas_solicitac: For questions, requests, or comments about privacy and use of data in ProdForge, use the email address below.
privacyPolicyPage_esta_politica_pode_ser: We may update this policy to reflect changes to the product, providers, features, security practices, analytics, AI, monetization, or applicable legal requirements.
privacyPolicyPage_quando_houver_mudancas: For significant changes, we may highlight the update on the website, in the workspace, or through another appropriate channel. The version published here shows the date of the last update.
privacyPolicyPage_esta_pagina_descreve_c: This page explains how ProdForge collects, uses, stores, and protects data when transforming briefs, rules, and product context into user stories, acceptance criteria, technical insights, and improvement suggestions.
privacyPolicyPage_a_politica_foi_escrita: This policy uses plain language to explain current and expected product practices. It does not promise absolute legal compliance or replace legal advice for sensitive cases, contracts, or regulatory requirements in your business.
